data.long_meaning: Derived from Sanskrit words ‘Deva’ (God) and ‘Hrid’ (warrior). In Hindu mythology, Devahrid is the divine warrior, representing power, courage, and devotion. The name Devahrid carries the meaning “God's warrior” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devahrid usually hope their child will grow to embody god's warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
